rules.expression: (http.host eq "s.conao3.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown"))

(http.host eq "s.conao3.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/blog/") and http.request.uri.path.extension eq "" and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown"))
(http.host eq "s.conao3.com" and http.request.uri.path.extension in {"md" "org"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preview/") and any(http.request.uri.args["preview"][*] eq "true"))
